headline: Council holds public hearing on fiscal year 2027 motor vehicle weight tax rates

meeting.body: Maui County Council Notice of Public Hearing
meeting.voteItem: Closing public testimony and accepting written testimony
meeting.summary: The council took public testimony on proposed motor vehicle weight tax rates for fiscal year 2027, with seven members present and two excused. The chair closed public testimony, accepted written testimony and adjourned the meeting.
meeting.recap: The council held a public hearing on proposed motor vehicle weight tax rates for fiscal year 2027.[[0:05:24]] The clerk reported seven members present and two excused.[[0:06:16]] The chair asked everyone to keep microphones muted unless it was their turn to speak.[[0:06:53]] The chair said testimony must be about items on the agenda.[[0:06:59]] Each testifier could speak for up to three minutes on each item.[[0:07:09]] A testifier said their testimony was broadly about the transportation industry.[[0:08:38]] The testifier spoke about large oil companies and the fuel tax.[[0:08:51]] The testifier also spoke about the history of a wealthy family and oil money in Iran.[[0:08:59]] The chair asked if members had questions for the testifier, and none were asked.[[0:11:34]] The clerk said no one else had signed up to testify and gave a last call.[[0:11:38]] No one else came forward to testify.[[0:11:47]] The chair closed public testimony and accepted written testimony.[[0:11:53]] The chair adjourned the meeting.[[0:12:01]]
decided: Public testimony was closed and written testimony was accepted with no objection recorded.

moments.q: Public hearing on motor vehicle weight tax rates comes to order
"So ordered and this meeting is adjourned."
